item.title: MetalFlight 0.1.8 Beta 5
item.description:
MetalFlight **0.1.8 Beta 5** updates the opt-in Preview channel. Stable remains **0.1.7**. This release adds runtime `2026.11.07-dev12-preview1` for testing the experimental issue #8 workaround. Updating the app alone does not install the runtime; select **Settings → Updates → Preview**, then install the runtime update.
### Issue #8 Preview experiment
- Adds a targeted TEB fiber stack preflight in Wine `ntdll` for the MSFS game process. It preserves Windows guard-page and `StackLimit` bookkeeping. - Enables the workaround only for `FlightSimulator2024.exe` through the game profile. Steam is not opted in. - The owned four-fiber positive control and disabled/wrong-target guard-page controls pass. The app's exact runtime install/reinstall/rollback check also passes. - **The PMDG 737-800 POS INIT and iFly 737 MAX 8 SID cases have not been tested with this Preview runtime. This is an experimental test build; the issue is not confirmed fixed.** Please report results and sanitized logs on [issue #8](https://github.com/AndreaCodinLife/metalflight/issues/8).
The runtime archive contains 1,866 inventoried files and 52 safe symlinks. The app is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. The Preview feed and update signatures use the existing Sparkle signing key. A full interactive updater transition between notarized releases remains unverified.
